edit_device.title: Edit {device_id}
edit_device.description:
Last values of {device_id}: **{values}**

**Additional IDs**: packets received with any of these IDs update the same entities (e.g. a probe whose ID changes when the batteries are replaced). Commands are always sent with the primary ID. Recently received compatible IDs are listed with their last values ({candidates} found); you can also type another ID in the field.

Changes are applied without re-creating the entities, so automations are not triggered.

learned_target.title: New device or additional ID?
learned_target.description:
**{device_id}** — last values: {values}

It uses the same protocol as devices already configured. If it is one of them with a new ID (battery change, replaced remote), add it as an additional ID: compare with the last values shown for each device.
